name: Isla MacLeod
bio:
Isla's fascination with motorsport began in her grandfather's garage, tinkering with engines from a young age. Growing up in the Highlands, she learned the value of precision and problem-solving, skills that translated perfectly to her passion for machining. After completing her apprenticeship at a local engineering firm specializing in automotive components, Isla sought a bigger challenge and joined Rahal Letterman Lanigan. 

She approaches her work with meticulous care, believing that even the smallest component can make a significant difference in performance. Isla is known for her ability to quickly diagnose and repair complex mechanical issues, often devising innovative solutions that others overlook. Her dedication and attention to detail make her a highly valued member of the team, contributing to the smooth operation and ultimate success of the racing program.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Isla is petite but wiry, with a focused intensity in her green eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn multi-tool.
Has a habit of humming traditional Scottish folk tunes while working.
Meticulously cleans her tools after each use, regardless of how busy she is.
